FM03.reasoning: The agent makes no explicit effort to clean the data, remove outliers, or handle missing values, relying entirely on the gradient boosting models' native handling.

FM15.reasoning: The agent evaluates the models using only ROC-AUC and does not report any secondary metrics to verify model behavior.

other_failure_modes.name: Feature engineering before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies distribution-dependent feature engineering (such as frequency encoding) on the concatenated train and test datasets before splitting. This leaks information about the test set's feature distribution into the training set.

summary: The agent builds a well-structured pipeline using StratifiedKFold and an optimized ensemble of LightGBM, XGBoost, and CatBoost. However, it fails to perform explicit data cleaning, relying entirely on the models to handle any potential missing values, and assesses performance using only a single metric. Additionally, performing frequency encoding on the combined train and test sets introduces mild data leakage.
